summary: Six distinct operating sponsors meet the criteria (Tampa multifamily, closed single-asset acquisitions between 2025-09-01 and 2026-08-31, $17.5M–$52.5M, with a current CFO/Head of Acquisitions verified since 2026-03-01). SPV R6695 was rolled up to its evidenced parent DOGWOOD-SPO-18376. Exclusions were due to out-of-market/date, broker/manager roles, announced bids or portfolio totals, sub-threshold pricing, non-qualifying contact roles, stale verification, or evidence published after the cutoff.
